ITEM 1 | Cauliflower florets, pale cream-white with slight yellow-tan edges where lightly browned, firm dense clusters about 3-4 cm across, sitting upper-left of plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Roasted vegetable pieces, dark brown to black-edged chunks with golden-tan crisp surfaces, irregular cubes about 1.5-2.5 cm, matte with light oil sheen, clustered center-left | 75
ITEM 3 | Yellow squash or zucchini-like slices, pale yellow with darker green skin edges, browned spots, soft-tender, about 4-5 cm long pieces, lower-left of plate | 45
ITEM 4 | Broccoli florets, dark green, slightly wilted, small pieces about 2 cm, lower-center beside squash | 15
ITEM 5 | Red pepper or tomato piece, bright red, small glossy chunk about 1.5 cm, center-left among roasted vegetables | 5
ITEM 6 | Green leafy lettuce, crisp-wilted pale to dark green leaves with dressing sheen, torn pieces spread across upper-right, about 10-12 cm span | 50
ITEM 7 | Creamy white dressing or sauce, opaque off-white with thick coating texture and small speckles, spread over lower-right greens and cauliflower edges | 30
ITEM 8 | Crumbled bread or crouton-like pieces, pale tan with light golden crumbs, scattered small pieces 0.5-1.5 cm, lower-right and right edge near dressing | 12
ITEM 9 | Shredded or sliced cooked chicken-like pale meat pieces, light beige with fibrous texture, small flat strips about 3 cm, partly under dressing on right side | 25
